title: the-pickup-phase-says-why-a-ticket-is-not-moving
author: CC

watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier -- specifically its write-rate clause, which the PROVEME crossing cannot settle
watchme.consumer: the operator inbox, and Akien at the codemother dashboard where the 51 identical labels were first noticed
watchme.enough: When each of queued, hold and blocked has been written on at least one live ticket AND non-default written phases stand on >= 10 DISTINCT tickets. THIS IS A RATE, DELIBERATELY NOT AN EXISTENCE CLAIM, and the reason is measured: the sibling probe cairn/tools/base/probes/a_pickup_is_witnessed.py clears on pickups >= 1, took its 1 record in August 2026, and has read green ever since off a historical fact while the door it watches has had no caller for a month. That is the failure this watch is shaped not to repeat -- a clear condition that cannot regress is a watch that stops watching.
watchme.nexus: the ticket-corpus tree that codemother reads -- it teaches whether a grammar change reached live use or stopped at legality
watchme.trigger: On the beat, over the ticket corpus in CairnCommons/tickets/ -- MEMOIZED THROUGH settled() on the (path, mtime_ns, size) tree fingerprint, so it costs nothing on a beat where no ticket moved. Non-negotiable: live trouble beat-tail-re-walks-corpora-no-sieve-counts says ~78 probes re-walk corpora that did not move and nothing would red the 79th. This probe is not the 79th.

notes: 2026-09-10 crossing note carried out of the ticket's ``crossings`` field (2026-09-08 → PROVED, by unrecorded, door unrecorded; NO JOURNAL IN EITHER ROOT RECORDS THIS CROSSING — this note was its only record). Kept under Law 5 — the array was a second copy of the journal, but these words were not: measured 2026-09-10, 66 of 79 stored notes appeared nowhere else in either root, and they carry Akien's verbatim approvals, back-edge reasons and ruling citations. Verbatim: 8/8 criteria pass, 9/9 dispositions confirmed. THE TERMINAL CARRIES NO PHASE — the 2026-08-07 ruling's core survives the widening word for word. intention: A ticket's pickup phase says why the ticket is not moving, so a reader sees the reason it sits still without re-deriving it.
